metadata.clan_summary:
[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC sase-z2[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Durable plan-archive publication for approved epic plans[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Approved plan files always reach the plans sidecar remote: the [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]epic-launch archive path publishes its plans-repo commits, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]workspace re-provisioning can no longer destroy the only copy of an[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]unpushed plans commit, and every plan lost to this defect (starting[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]with 202609/unified_agents_across_machines.md) is backfilled and [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]verified against the sidecar remote.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]4[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]2[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]
[dim]   Path: [#87AFFF][/dim]plan:202609/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]durable_plan_archive_publication.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim] Prompt: [#87AFFF][/dim]prompts/202609/durable_plan_archive_publication.md[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Bead: [#87AFFF][/dim]sase-z2[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Page: [#87AFFF][/dim]https://github.com/sase-org/sase--beads/blob/main/pages/sase-z2/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]README.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Publish plans-repo commits made by the epic launch path[/bold #D7AFFF]       [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]launch-plan-push[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]launch-plan-push: make `sase bead work <plan.md>` publish its plan [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]archive and bead-link commits to the plans sidecar remote instead of [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]leaving them local-only, and surface publication failures instead of [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]swallowing them.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Protect unpushed sidecar commits from workspace [/bold #D7AFFF]              [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]re-provisioning[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]prep-clone-protection[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]prep-clone-protection: find the code path that deletes and re-creates a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]workspace's sase/repos/<role> sidecar clones, and extend the existing [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]publish-or-rescue protection (today bead-store-only) to every sidecar [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]role so an unpushed plans commit can never be silently destroyed.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Detect and repair missing archived plans[/bold #D7AFFF]                      [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]plan-archive-doctor[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]plan-archive-doctor: add a doctor-style check that cross-references plan[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]beads, sidecar links/ indexes, and the canonical plans directory against[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the plans sidecar, reporting approved plans whose archived copy is [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]missing, with a confirmed repair mode that re-archives recoverable plans[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF](restoring bead_id frontmatter) and pushes.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Backfill the lost plans on this machine and verify[/bold #D7AFFF]            [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]backfill-athena[dim] · [dim][/dim]after launch-plan-push, plan-archive-doctor[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]backfill-athena: run the repair for every recoverable missing plan on [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]this machine — 202609/unified_agents_across_machines.md first — verify [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the sidecar remote now serves them with correct bead_id frontmatter, and[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]record follow-ups for plans only recoverable from another machine.[/#D7D7AF]

commits.subject: feat(beads): add plan archive doctor repair
fix(workspace): protect sidecar clones before eviction
